## Design

### 2026-10-27: Day 1 Week 4 - Beginnings

**3h**

Day 1 Week 4 - Beginnings

Today I conceptualized and created the first schematic of Pixxcraft. I decided to make a simple (kinda) project this time, just a little keychain-sized thingy where you can paint an image like MS Paint, and apply simple animations like scrolling pixels, fading, or sizing up/down, otherwise you can hand-draw them. Keep in mind they aren't supposed to be like full-on animations, just simple GIFs, like wind blowing or smoke coming out of the chimney of a house drawing.

Concept (my amazing drawing skills show here):
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5Di8qxPvTjh464E0buJSS1rL8xZfVQiB/eb82e20a55bba2f1de3c77b5b57140cf9a063843d56211e8e3099eca5cb45d7a.png)

Next, I looked for a good TFT color touchscreen, or at least a footprint/schematic for one. For now, I'm going to use a Connector, 01x12, to be specific. I wired up the pins and then to the ESP32-S3, which will be the main brains of this project.

The wired up TFT:

![Screenshot 2026-10-26 234821](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5Di8qxPvTjh464E0buJSS1rL8xZfVQiB/fec2908c859cf31604cf70f4d18c4d2acbdb29531b8a2b6a75c35e4c1f2fd416.png)

Finally, the way I want to go forward with this project is software. The screen I might be using already has a library, I'm going to use that and write the code for it. Perhaps I could make it stylus compatible, for the real artists? Right now, this project doesn't have too much ambition, especially since I have 2 pins left after adding the TFT.
